title: Microsoft 365 Copilot Pre-Rollout Security Readiness Assessment
agency_path: City of New York > Teachers' Retirement System
description_text:
TRS seeks an independent vendor to perform a focused, risk-based security assessment before Copilot licenses are activated for end users.

The engagement is limited to assessment and recommendations. The vendor will not change production configurations or implement remediation.

 * Validate the security controls protecting the pilot.
 * Identify material conditions that could expose TRS information.
 * Identify required pre-rollout remediation.
 * Provide a clear readiness determination.
